llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk: it generates storyboard and comic-writing text and includes a local script that runs an embedded Python program. Before installing, note that the script calls python3 (so ensure python3 is available). There are no network calls or credential requests. If you want extra caution, inspect the script locally before running and consider disabling autonomous invocation if you do not want the agent to call the skill without prompting.
